description: This file defines the BatchStepSensorFragment class, a fragment for an Android application that demonstrates and manages step sensor functionalities, including step counting and step detection with sensor batching options. It controls UI cards, manages sensor registration and unregistration, and maintains application state related to sensor data collection.

classes.name: BatchStepSensorFragment
classes.description: An Android Fragment that handles step detection and counting sensors, manages UI cards for user interaction, and maintains sensor state, demonstrating batching capabilities and sensor event handling in a step tracking app.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Initializes the UI cards and sensor setup when the fragment comes to the foreground, showing registration options if sensors are supported.

methods.name: onPause
methods.description: Unregisters sensor event listeners to conserve resources when the fragment is paused.

methods.name: isKitkatWithStepSensor
methods.description: Checks if the device runs Android KitKat or higher and supports step counter and detector sensors.

methods.name: onCardClick
methods.description: Handles user interactions with UI cards to register/deregister sensors and dismiss informational cards.

methods.name: registerEventListener
methods.description: Registers the sensor event listener with specified batching delay and updates UI accordingly.

methods.name: onSensorChanged
methods.description: Handles incoming sensor events for step detection and counting, updating UI and internal counters.

methods.name: recordDelay
methods.description: Records timestamp delays of sensor events for diagnostics.

methods.name: getDelayString
methods.description: Returns a formatted string of recent sensor event delays.

methods.name: onSaveInstanceState
methods.description: Saves current sensor and app state for restoring after configuration changes.

methods.name: onActivityCreated
methods.description: Restores saved state, reinitializes sensors, and maintains counters after configuration changes.

methods.name: showCountingCards
methods.description: Displays step counting UI cards and resets counters.

methods.name: showRegisterCard
methods.description: Shows sensor registration options to the user.

methods.name: showErrorCard
methods.description: Displays an error message card if sensors are unsupported.

methods.name: initialiseCards
methods.description: Creates and adds all UI cards used in the app.

methods.name: getCardStream
methods.description: Retrieves the CardStream fragment used for UI card management.
